title: The SDK build lab, step by step

steps.title: 01 Credentials
steps.body: glean-idx doctor with your datasource proves the token works.

steps.title: 02 Data client
steps.body: Cursor paging, a limiter below the source quota, max_attempts raised.

steps.title: 03 Guard
steps.body: A unit test proves an empty page before the end raises and nothing uploads.

steps.title: 04 Transform
steps.body: Stable IDs, epoch seconds, group and intersection ACLs.

steps.title: 05 Identities
steps.body: Users, groups, and memberships pushed before streaming content.

steps.title: 06 Tests
steps.body: Mock, then integration with negative identities configured.

steps.title: 07 Live
steps.body: A full run on the disposable datasource; document access checked for three personas.

steps.title: 08 Incremental
steps.body: Override the checkpoint; run incremental after source changes; explain why deletions need their own path.

footnote: The lab runs outside this package, in your own repository and a disposable test datasource provided by your program. Your assessor scores the lab evidence.
